purpose: Curated visual authority for Rex Fleet sequential comic production. Released Issue 1 story pages are the visual baseline; page 1 editorial material and covers are excluded from story-page style authority.

rules: Released Issue 1 story pages 2–19 control established identity, faction/world design, palette, lettering and comic-page language.
Select the actual released page that visibly anchors each recurring element; never infer a character-to-page mapping from retired production IDs.
Approved production pages may establish newer story state but do not redesign unchanged released identity.
Rejected, failed, repeated, superseded, promotional or chat-only generations are not visual authority.
The released Issue 1 cover is mandatory pixel-read authority for Rex Fleet cover trade dress only; later cover composition remains issue-specific.

references.use: Mandatory pixel-read reference before Rex Fleet cover generation. Controls cover branding/trade dress only; never use as interior page-style authority or as a mandatory later-cover composition template.

characterReferenceRule: For a recurring released character, visually select the clearest matching Issue 1 story-page reference before generation. Text visualAnchor data supplements that artwork and does not replace it.
coverReferenceRule: Before every Rex Fleet cover generation, retrieve and visually inspect issue-01-cover as pixels. Use it for masthead, logo, issue-number block, tagline/divider, cover-brand rhythm and bottom emblem system only. The active cover recipe controls issue-specific image composition.
